_README_1_: CURATED ability_rules.json — Beelzebub v0.5.2 — initial pass for all 60 V-Bloods. Drop this file into BepInEx\config\kdpen.Beelzebub\ on the server (overwrites any existing ability_rules.json). Use .beelz admin reload to hot-reload while the server is running.
_README_2_: Each entry under AbilityMap is a curated guess. Where Weapons is empty, the ability is universal (Magic). Where TransformOnly is true, .beelz grant will refuse to bind the ability — it only fires while transformed. Forms gates which native shapeshift form (Wolf/Bear/Rat/Spider/Toad) the ability is associated with.
_README_3_: Review with your friends, edit freely, and re-upload. The source-of-truth lives in docs/ability_map.curated.json in the repo; copy it into your live config when ready.
